---
title: "HTML format"
format: html
filters:
  - code-style
---

The same extension works on `format: html` for plain document output. Without
reveal.js fragments, progressive specs collapse to either the **last** step
(default) or all steps **merged**.

## Last step (default)

````markdown
```{.r data-code-style="|hi:2|rem:3,add:4-7|hi:8"}
df |>
  ...
```
````

```{.r data-code-style="|hi:2|rem:3,add:4-7|hi:8"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(
    m = mean(mpg),
    .by = gear
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## Merged

Set `data-code-style-static="merged"` to overlay every step's marks at once.

````markdown
```{.r data-code-style="|hi:2|rem:3,add:4-7|hi:8"
        data-code-style-static="merged"}
df |>
  ...
```
````

```{.r data-code-style="|hi:2|rem:3,add:4-7|hi:8" data-code-style-static="merged"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(
    m = mean(mpg),
    .by = gear
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## Static still works

````markdown
```{.r data-code-style="add:2-3, rem:5"}
df |>
  ...
```
````

```{.r data-code-style="add:2-3, rem:5"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```
